assessment_md:
**How it's doing:** The strategy is quiet right now (signal=0, price ~$63,891). It remains highly selective, so trades accumulate slowly — we still only have a handful.

**What changed vs last time:** Almost nothing. The ledger is unchanged at 5 resolved trades, total **-41 bps** (mean -8.2 bps/trade, 1 win of 5). The rolling 8-bet window shows win rate 0.5, gross **-0.46 bps** and net **-3.46 bps** after 3 bps costs. So results are still slightly negative, roughly as before.

**What the numbers do and don't tell us:** With only 5-8 bets, these figures are dominated by luck. One trade (-22.8 bps on 2026-07-17) accounts for over half the ledger loss, and the most recent trade was actually a winner (+3.1 bps net). That kind of swing from a single bet is exactly why a few dozen trades — at minimum — are needed before any conclusion. Note the strategy was pre-validated as *marginal*: ~4 bps gross edge against a ~3.9 bps breakeven cost, so it may not be net-profitable even if it works as designed. The edge-search survivor count is 0 at the stricter 5 bps bar.

**Bottom line:** Too thin to judge. Live results lean negative but are well within noise for this sample size. No action warranted; keep collecting data and do not assume any profit.
